mission: To represent Makurdi and Benue State with pride, play exciting, winning football, develop players and staff the right way, and give back to the community that has always stood by the Red and Gold.

values.title: Pride
values.text: We wear the Red and Gold for Benue. Every match, every training session and every visit to the community carries the club's name.

values.title: Community
values.text: The club belongs to its supporters. We stay close to our fans, schools and local football, on and off matchday.

values.title: Discipline
values.text: Hard work, respect and fair play: towards team-mates, opponents, officials and supporters.

values.title: Ambition
values.text: We aim to compete for trophies and represent Nigeria with distinction.

values.title: Integrity
values.text: We are honest and open in how the club is run, and we keep our promises to fans and partners.
